summary: @ornikar/rollup-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (node setup.mjs) downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmods the Bun binary, then invokes a bundled sibling file math_init.js under that runtime via execFileSync. math_init.js is a ~727KB Bun-compiled bundle (starts with the `// @bun @bun-cjs` marker) whose body is javascript-obfuscator output (shuffled string-array + rotator, `_0x`/random-name identifiers) that is not human-inspectable and is not referenced by the package's advertised rollup configuration purpose. setup.mjs itself is also obfuscated with per-function string-lookup tables aliasing fs/https/zlib/child_process imports and hiding URL, header, and OS-detection literals (Alpine, musl, /etc/os-release, ldd --version, Expand-Archive). The combination — installing a second language runtime at install time solely to execute an opaque compiled payload from a package whose stated purpose is a rollup config helper, with the dropper itself obfuscated — is an install-time remote code execution vector with unknown post-exploit behavior on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
